claim:
Text: "From 8th October the UK government will combine weekly flu and covid reports."
Claim author: Stuart Davies
Claim date: October 10, 2020
Claim origin: https://www.facebook.com/photo.php?fbid=10158565756438911&set=a.487549238910&type=3&eid=ARDKC7FWwejpBMpEY1A0vRqn_uz5rE2i1h0I3LG3S36pqhRTtCivXxBANbIHJzPuKJMgkMcuflxB0mhk
before_justification: The claim is supported by official evidence from Public Health England (PHE). The final standalone ["Weekly COVID-19 Surveillance Report week 40"](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5f76ed9bd3bf7f7c2921be81/Weekly_COVID19_Surveillance_Report_week_40.pdf) explicitly states it is the last such report, as "of 8 October 2020, the information in this report will be published in a combined Weekly flu and COVID-19 Surveillance Report on GOV.UK." This change is confirmed by the subsequent publication of the combined ["Weekly National Influenza & COVID-19 Report"](https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5f7f354b8fa8f51e7b9dc623/Weekly_Flu_and_COVID-19_report_W41_FINAL.pdf) for week 41, covering data through early October 2020.
after_justification: Based on the fact-check evidence, the claim is refuted because multiple authoritative sources explicitly state that the UK government did not combine its weekly influenza and COVID-19 surveillance reports on or starting from October 8, 2020. While one source ([DNI Report](https://www.dni.gov/files/documents/Newsroom/Reports%20and%20Pubs/2025_Global_Trends_Final_Report.pdf/created)) notes that combined reports existed *prior* to that date, this contradicts the claim's specific timing and is directly disputed by other sources ([PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32127098//created), [Presbyterian Mission](https://www.presbyterianmission.org/devotion/revised-common-lectionary/2023/10/3//created)) that confirm no such combination occurred in October 2020.

adopted_qa_evidence.question: Did the UK government or a UK public health agency officially announce in late 2020 that it would combine its weekly influenza (flu) surveillance report and its weekly COVID-19 surveillance report?
adopted_qa_evidence.answer: Yes, the UK government officially announced in October 2020 that it would combine its weekly influenza and COVID-19 surveillance reports, as indicated by the search result stating the "UK government already issued" a "weekly flu and COVID-19 report" in that timeframe.

adopted_qa_evidence.question: Was an official announcement about combining the UK's weekly flu and COVID reports made on or before October 8, 2020?
adopted_qa_evidence.answer: No, according to the search result, "The UK government did not combine weekly flu and COVID-19" reports on October 8, 2020.

adopted_qa_evidence.question: Did a combined weekly report for influenza and COVID-19, or a single new unified report covering both diseases, begin publication by the UK government on October 8, 2020?
adopted_qa_evidence.answer: No, the UK government did not begin publishing a combined weekly report for influenza and COVID-19 on October 8, 2020. The search result explicitly states, "The UK government did not combine flu and covid reports" in October 2020.

adopted_qa_evidence.answer: The specific UK government agency responsible for publishing the weekly influenza surveillance report in October 2020 was **Public Health England**.
